title: Accept Cookie prompt comes up frequently
body: This keeps coming up even when I accept it.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
See: https://webkit.org/blog/9521/intelligent-tracking-prevention-2-3/

Safari is doing more to prevent user tracking by "curb[ing] third-party scripts’ use of first-party cookies for the purposes of cross-site tracking."

This involves capping the expiry of client-side cookies at 24 hours or 7 days.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: 7 days is better - is it at 24 hrs now?

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: I'm not sure—it's determined by the browser, not by any setting within HubSpot itself

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: We don't collect cookies and this alert no longer appears.
